Name: Content Patcher Json Processor
Author: jltaylor1
Description:
This is a mod for Content Patcher mod authors.  There's no need to install it unless some other mod you want to use lists it as a dependency.

Content Patcher Json Processor provides integration between [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13183]Json Processor[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ so that you can use Json Processor transformers inside a Content Patcher [font=Courier New]content.json[/font].

For documentation, see [url=https://github.com/jltaylor-us/StardewJsonProcessor/tree/default/ContentPatcherJsonProcessor]GitHub[/url].

Manifest.Name: Content Patcher Json Processor
Manifest.Description: Allows Content Patcher content packs to use the Json Processesor transformers
Manifest.Author: Jamie Taylor
